items.description: Run, fight or flee! In Powder Runners: Maze Quest, you alone or with your team will face dangerous mazes against opponents and traps. Do you have what it takes to come out on top and achieve glory?Play alone or call your friends.Powder Runners: Maze Quest is an action, adventure and strategy game where every second counts! Enter treacherous mazes full of traps and enemies, where the goal is simple: be the first to reach the Magic Portal and Win! But be careful – other players are also after victory, and they won't make your journey easy! items.description: ADD TO YOUR WISHLIST:Order from Caos is an epic tale of a man who got his life changed by an evil entity whose sole purpose is to destroy everything humankind has ever built. Dan, the main protagonist, feels as if he was cursed by this being and tries to find a way to bring him down. He will travel alongside a few companions, all with similar stories of loss like his. He never thought actually of having a group or even a family, but he will find something greater than vengeance to fight for: love. In the meantime, while trying to gather the support of every nation of this world, Dan must protect those he love and also himself, not knowing that perhaps this evil instinct may be within... Follow the path of an ordinary man who can overcome extraordinary things.Order from Caos is strongly inspired by the true JRPG classics.+30 hours to finish the whole game with 100% completion.+50 quests between the main ones and sidequests +200 NPCs to interact+200 items (weapons, armors and items)+100 skills+100 enemies+10 locationsSo, fight your way into discovering what it means to live with the curse of CAOS.A = OKB = CancelX = ShiftY = MenuLB = Page upRB = Page downD-pad up = UpD-pad down = DownD-pad left = LeftD-pad right = RightTab = TabEnter = OkShift = ShiftControl = ControlAlt = ControlEscape = EscapeSpace = OkPage up = Page upPage Down = Page DownLeft Arrow = LeftRight Arrow = RightUp Arrow = UpDown Arrow - DownInsert = EscapeQ = Page UpW = Page DownX = EscapeZ = Ok[/img]DAN Protagonist of the game. He has a strong sense of justice. all his powers are directed to killing CAOS. He's lost all his family and his health due to his enemy. He searches tirelessly for a way to save himself and save humankind in the process.DHALIAA powerful witch who studies the supernatural. Her intelligence surpasses even the renowned scholars. She's very serious and has a twisted sense of humor. She is one of the few with the means to discover the truth behind the true reason for CAOS' very existence.TINAAn adorable young lady. Very polite and different from her aunt DHALIA. She studies healing spells and magic as a whole. She doubts herself often, however she knows that deep inside of her there's a power beyond comprehension.JOHHe is an enthusiast of everything that has mechanic components. Even if cars are considered old things, he loves them and also loves to drive. He's always in a good mood, lives a simple life and is a good friend of TINA.HAROLDEA man who wanders around the world fighting against demons that get in his way. He walks as if he wanted to die to cure his broken heart. A sad soul, a powerful warrior looking for his Last Battle.LANAHer best friend is a weapon, a dragon with the power of an A-bomb. A princess of a long destroyed kingdom who suffers with the control of her father and the military. A woman without fear and without social skills. items.description: A Dark Agent, A Deadly MissionDude The Dark Agent is a 2.5D action game that blends the classic 90s FPS spirit with modern features. Hunt down enemy soldiers, smash ancient statues, and survive against dangers lurking around every corner in dense jungle maps rendered with the raycasting engine.### ⚔️ Choose Your ArmoryInstantly switch between four different weapons:- **Shotgun** — Devastating power at close range- **AK-47** — Automatic fire, mid-range dominance- **Uzi** — Rapid fire, ambush-style combat- **Knife** — Silent and deadly close combat### 🏆 Skill Tree & ShopUpgrade your skills with the gold and diamonds you collect:- Increase your health and armor capacity- Upgrade your weapon power- Improve your drop rate- Buy ammo, health, and armor from the shop### 👥 Local Splitscreen for Up to 4 PlayersFight on the same screen with your friends! 2, 3, or 4-player splitscreen mode comes with full gamepad support. Each player chooses their own character, carries their own weapon, and determines their own fate.### 🗺️ Level Editor & Automatic DesignCreate your own maps with the built-in level editor. items.description: Super Star Adventure is the 1-bit RPG that with active combat using direction inputs and timing to dodge each attack! Simple, but everything on Astralis is either broken, cursed, alive, or some combo of the three. You'll explore the planet, barter with shady shops, and maybe punch a Shardkin or two.Combat’s tactical but snappy. Dialogue’s weird.
